(b) config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt declares `gControllerButtons = .sbss:0x803445C8; size:0x4` and `sFlags = .sbss:0x803445CC; size:0x4` as two separate four-byte objects. Our screensaver.c declares `extern s64 gControllerButtons;`, so `(gControllerButtons & 8)` is a 64-bit AND whose LOW half our object relocates as `gControllerButtons+0x4`; the dtk-extracted target object has no original relocations at all and names the same address `sFlags` purely by split-map address lookup. Both resolve to 0x803445CC, so there is no defect to fix in source.
